<thought>To obtain the possible precursors, I will first search the template catalog for a retrosynthetic template that breaks an S‑Cl bond and forms an N‑S bond, which corresponds to the sulfonamide formation described. This should return the appropriate template ID(s) that can then be applied to the target molecule.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "O=S(NC1=CC(N2CCN(C(OC(C)(C)C)=O)CC2)=C3C(CCC4(CCC4)O3)=C1)(C5=C(F)C=CC=C5)=O",
    "bonds_broken": ["S-Cl"],
    "bonds_formed": ["N-S"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
